title: Severe Turbulence Lasted 55% Longer Over The North Atlantic
hook: Severe turbulence lasted 55% longer over the North Atlantic.
closing: The seatbelt sign matters more as rough air becomes more common.
question: Have your flights felt bumpier?

segments.say: Severe turbulence reached 27.4 annual hours. North Atlantic flights now spend more time in rough air.
Severe turbulence duration rose 55 percent. The roughest air grew faster than lighter bumps.
Models project 62 annual hours by 2080. Future crossings could encounter far more severe turbulence.
